depiction.primary_object: two concentric black rings around a solid center dot
depiction.composition: single symmetrical object, centered front view

ambiguity: Can resemble a selected radio button, a vinyl record, a stove burner coil, or a radar/ripple animation at very small sizes, though having two outer rings clearly favors a bullseye target.

reasoning: A classic concentric bullseye target, universally understood both literally (archery, shooting, darts targets) and metaphorically (goals, objectives, OKRs, targets). Note for US English users: 'Target' the retail store uses this logo, but shopping errands belong under a shopping bag or cart icon unless specifically differentiated.
